I dey farm this maize for rented land, small plot of 0.75 hectare here for South West. Money no plenty, but if I no put small fertilizer, the maize no go yield anything, so I go buy small NPK and urea when I get money, maybe side-dress when the maize reach knee high. I dey intercrop with cowpea and small cassava like my papa teach me, and I go use the local seed wey I keep from last year because improved seed too cost and the land no be my own. For weeding and pest, I go spray small herbicide to save my back, and me and my wife and pikin go do most of the work, but I go call two or three men for the weeding and harvest time.
